parts.name: back_cushion_egg_chair
sources: A pad of a knife edge, 13 cm thick at the middle: its cover sewn from 2 pieces (World.Sewing.Cushion).
Egg chair cushions of a seat and a back, 4 to 7 in thick (Sunnydaze: Penelope, a seat 7 in and a back 6 in; Caroline, 4 in).
A cover of solution-dyed fabric for cushions, 8.00 oz per square yard (271 g/m2: the furniture grade of Sunbrella, Outdoor Fabrics).
A fill of polyester fiber, 200 to 300 g for a cushion of 40 by 40 cm (Rijs Textiles: fiberfill): about 25 kg/m3 in its volume.
